context_requirements: Expression of the targeted SLC transporter or CFTR in the assayed cell line
Functional dependence on the transported solute for growth or survival
Ion or solute gradient that the transporter normally maintains
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Selective sensitivity of a line that expresses the targeted transporter compared with a line that does not
Rescue of the transcriptional response by co-treatment with the transported solute or by transporter overexpression
